hero.findings:
HIGH     NX: disabled  BIN-MITIGATION-NX
           Injected data on the stack/heap can be executed as code (classic shellcode).
           • PT_GNU_STACK is RWX (executable stack)
  HIGH     Calls memory-unsafe C library functions  BIN-UNSAFE-API
           Unbounded copies / formatting (CWE-676, CWE-120). `gets` can never be used safely.
           • gets ← main
           • strcpy ← greet
           • system ← win
  MEDIUM   PIE: disabled  BIN-MITIGATION-PIE
           Code is loaded at a fixed address, so ROP gadgets have predictable addresses.
           • fixed load address (ET_EXEC)
  MEDIUM   RELRO: disabled  BIN-MITIGATION-RELRO
           The GOT stays writable: a write primitive can redirect library calls.
           • no PT_GNU_RELRO
  MEDIUM   Stack canary: disabled  BIN-MITIGATION-STACK-CANARY
           Stack buffer overflows can overwrite return addresses undetected.
           • no __stack_chk_fail reference
  INFO     FORTIFY_SOURCE: disabled  BIN-MITIGATION-FORTIFY_SOURCE
           Compiled without -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE (or no fortifiable calls).
           • no *_chk functions
  INFO     create process  CAP-PROC-CREATE
           namespace: host-interaction/process/create
           • api: system
           ATT&CK: T1106
